mapper.select: SELECT bbs07_comment_id AS comment_id , bbs07_person_id AS person_id , ( '<'||'b'||'>'|| f_emp_kor_nm(bbs07_person_id) ||' ('|| f_get_empTrans(bbs07_person_id, bbs07_date::date, 'org_code_nm') ||' '|| f_get_empTrans(bbs07_person_id, bbs07_date::date, 'pos_nm') ||') '|| '<'||'/b'||'>'|| TO_CHAR(bbs07_date,'YY.MM.DD') ||' '|| bbs07_time ) AS comment_full_str , ( SELECT '파일('||COUNT(sys10_file_id)||')' FROM sys10_file WHERE sys10_parent_id = bbs07_comment_id ) AS file_str , ( CASE WHEN bbs07_person_id = #{personId} THEN '✕' ELSE '' END ) AS delete_str , bbs07_comment AS comment FROM bbs07_comment WHERE bbs07_notice_id = #{noticeId} AND bbs07_company_id = #{companyId} ORDER BY bbs07_date, bbs07_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bbs07_comment (bbs07_comment_id, bbs07_company_id, bbs07_person_id, bbs07_notice_id, bbs07_date, bbs07_time, bbs07_comment) VALUES (#{commentId}, #{companyId}, #{personId}, #{noticeId}, f_sysdate(), TO_CHAR(f_sysdate(), 'HH24:MI:SS'), #{comment})
